title: HtmlWbr
responsibility: Renders the native wbr element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlWbr.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte child snippet accepted by the component. It is destructured but not rendered because this component emits the void <wbr> element with an empty body.

outputs.name: HtmlWbr
outputs.description: The native <wbr> element rendered by this component, with all props except children spread onto it as attributes. Its body is empty, so the component adds no wrapper and renders no child content.
